Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance

Spoiler-free 100% completion of both canons and all current Windows content · 50 areas · 1642 tracked items

This page shows everything, including exact locations. It exists so you can search for one specific collectible and find it. If you are playing blind, use the interactive spoiler-free version instead — it hides locations until you ask for them, one item at a time.

Windows definitive route

Route record

HintUse the current native PC build.
WhereLaunch Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance on Windows with update content installed.
Full detailRecord the game version, difficulty, owned optional add-ons, and any detected legacy-save bonus before opening a new file. The archive route needs no console replay because Windows contains the complete high-fidelity release.

Canon of Creation route (missable)

Campaign record

HintThe opening choice controls which campaign ledger is active.
WhereChoose Canon of Creation at the opening branch and keep a separate slot.
Full detailSelect the Creation branch at the first route prompt. Do not overwrite its initial save with the other campaign: field variants, requests, encounters, outcomes, and carried trainer data must be reconciled across both branches.

Canon of Vengeance route (missable)

Campaign record

HintReturn to the opening branch on a separate run.
WhereChoose Canon of Vengeance at the opening branch and keep a separate slot.
Full detailBegin the Vengeance branch from a fresh or qualifying carried file. Keep it distinct from the Creation slot, finish its exclusive requests and field records, and preserve its clear mark for the combined Virtual Trainer ledger.

No Stone Unturned (missable)

Optional request record

HintTalk to peaceful contacts and revisit old regions after access changes.
WhereActivate this request from Neko Shogun near Hamamatsucho, near Da'at: Minato - Shiba; it is available in both campaigns.
Full detailPin the request and satisfy its live objective until the counter reaches 5.
